caption: : Avg. performance across 5 datasets (NQ, TQA, zsRE, T-rex, HQA). Blue bars show performance with relevant context, while purple bars show performance without it.  (w/) denotes CINGS (W/ CONTEXT SUP.).

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the average performance across different methods categorized by context presence, using a variety of bars to show distinct methods. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled as "With Context" and "Without Context". The vertical axis is labeled "Average Performance," ranging from 0 to 60, with tick intervals of 10. The chart displays bars that are distinguished by color and pattern: under "With Context," there are three bars, one in blue with circles representing "Standard", one in solid blue for "CInGS (w/)", and a solid blue bar for "CInGS", reaching a height of 56, 57 and 60 respectively. For the "Without Context" section, there are three purple bars of height around 45, 47, and 43, respectively, corresponding to the same three methods. The bars are grouped by the context category and sorted based on the predefined method sequences from the legend, which distinguishes methods using patterns and solid fills without emphasizing any particular bar.
